---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it would enable.

**Example scenario:**
"As a game designer, I want to [do something] so that [benefit]."

## Proposed Solution

How do you envision this feature working?

### Proposed DSL Syntax

If applicable, show how this feature might look in a .pg file:

```
game "Feature Demo"

player {
    color blue
    height 75
    width 50
}

// New feature example
new_feature {
    // How would it work?
}
```

### Expected Generated Code

If relevant, describe what Python code this should generate or how it should behave.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Benefits

Why would this be useful to pygame_sl users?

- Benefit 1
- Benefit 2
- ...

## Implementation Complexity

If you have technical knowledge, estimate the complexity:
- [ ] Simple (minor addition)
- [ ] Moderate (requires some refactoring)
- [ ] Complex (major feature)
- [ ] Unsure

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can provide additional examples/use cases
- [ ] I'm just suggesting the idea
